Low-grade fever
No relief from empirical treatment for urinary tract infection

Urine β-hCG was negative

Mild anemia
Normal renal and hepatic function tests

shortlist: Clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma

shortlist.label: Renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large, heterogeneously attenuating right renal mass with invasion of the collecting system, right renal vein, and inferior vena cava

shortlist.label: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Gross hematuria, flank pain, and low-grade fever with a renal mass, consistent with papillary renal cell carcinoma presentation

shortlist.label: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Renal mass with cystic change and hemorrhage, which can be seen in chromophobe renal cell carcinoma

shortlist.label: Collecting duct carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Invasion of the collecting system, which is a characteristic feature of collecting duct carcinoma

shortlist.label: Clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large renal mass with hyperattenuation suggesting hemorrhage, which can be seen in clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with gross hematuria, flank pain, and a large, heterogeneously attenuating renal mass with invasion of the collecting system, renal vein, and inferior vena cava, along with multiple pulmonary nodules, is most consistent with renal cell carcinoma, which is known for its potential to cause hematuria, pain, and metastasis.

rejected.label: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While possible, papillary renal cell carcinoma is less likely given the lack of specific features such as papillary structures on imaging.

rejected.label: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma typically presents as a well-circumscribed mass, which does not match the infiltrative appearance described in the case.

rejected.label: Collecting duct carcinoma
rejected.why: Collecting duct carcinoma is rare and usually presents with more advanced disease, but the imaging features do not specifically suggest this subtype over renal cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Clear cell papillary renal cell carcinoma is less aggressive and typically does not show the extensive invasion and metastasis seen in this case.
